narrative.headline: Inspect real Japan room offers with explicit dates, party and price units.
narrative.value_prop: Search Rakuten Travel public pages, inspect property details and compare bounded date alternatives. Keep room and plan identities, source price labels and booking links intact.
narrative.auth_narrative: The public website backend requires no API credentials or browser. The separately documented official APIs require an application ID and access key and are not used by these commands.
narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan accommodation discovery and explicit date/party room-plan inspection on Rakuten Travel. Resolve candidates, inspect an offer, then hand off to Rakuten to book.
